snippet.title: Corebreaker | Latin American Games Showcase SGF 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Corebreaker is a fast-paced action-platformer game with rogue-like elements. Play as Nova, a robot designed to awaken when humanity is extinct by the machines. Unlock abilities, upgrades and powerful weapons as you fight your way through supreme robots to find out your purpose!
